title: Generating Socially Acceptable Perturbations for Efficient Evaluation of Autonomous Vehicles
reasoning: The paper's core methodology revolves around creating 'socially acceptable' attacks, which are defined by attributing responsibility for a crash to the autonomous vehicle. To achieve this, it explicitly incorporates a formalization of the legal concept of 'Duty of Care' from Tort law, using the Responsibility-Sensitive Safety (RSS) model. The reward function for the attacking agent is designed based on these rules of responsibility and fault, making the evaluation of ethical and legal principles a central component of the proposed method, rather than a brief consideration.
